sources.snippet: Real-time streaming speech-to-text using NVIDIA NeMo with the nemotron-speech-streaming-en-.6b model loaded from a local .nemo file. No HuggingFace cache, no API — pure local inference.

sources.snippet: English Nemotron Core AI streaming contract The model is a component bundle with a host RNN-T decoder. It does not turn arbitrary PCM directly into a string in one graph invocation. Use CoreAISpeechRunner.swift and SwiftTranscribe.swift for the tested executable macOS example.
